policy_notes: Explosive Runes is a complete secret using the existing live enemy-minion played condition, canonical LOOT_101 key and public DamageExcessToHero.

Source Spell Damage and SOURCE numeric/flow rules are quoted once, then current positive minion HP assigns the primary parcel and the remainder to the original controller hero. TARGET rules, shielding, immunity and armor act on the assigned parcels without reallocating remainder.
Both parcels use the existing simultaneous health settlement before common death/reactions, retain SPELL attribution and never apply source Spell Damage twice.

Primary historical reports describe Divine Shield and target multiplier interactions; they are not current official CN calibration. Source multiplier/conversion/routing and exact batch timing remain explicitly local policies.

record.name: 爆炸符文
record.text: 奥秘：在你的对手使用一张随从牌后，对该随从造成$6点伤害，超过其生命值的伤害将由对方英雄 承受。
record.text_en: Secret: After your opponent plays a minion, deal $6 damage to it and any excess to their hero.
